User: How to make korean fried chicken
Assistant:

Do this first: Gather ingredients for Korean Fried Chicken, which typically include the following items - pounded and marinated boneless skinless chicken thighs (or drumsticks), flour mixture with spices like garlic powder, onion granules, salt & pepper.
 🍗: Purchase or prepare quality raw meat for frying; freshness is key to great flavor!  ✅ Once you have these items at hand - proceed as follows :   
If that didn’=/n worked (i.e., if ingredients are unavailable), then what I need from you/is: Identify nearby stores or online suppliers for the following essential components 🛒- boneless skinless chicken thighs, flour mixture with spices like garlic powder and onion granules.
  ✅ Once these ingredients are available - continue to next step :   
Do this: Prepare marinade using Korean gochujang (Korean red pepper paste), soy sauce or fish sauce, sesame oil for flavor enhancement and a bit of sugar. Mix well until uniform in taste 🔪- mix ingredients thoroughly to ensure even coating on chicken  ✅ After marinading your meat - proceed with following steps:
If that didn't work (i.e., if the mixture lacks depth or flavor), then what I need from you/is : Suggest additional spices like ginger, sesame seeds to enrich taste such as a pinch of finely chopped fresh ginger 🌶️: Finer ingredients often add extra layers in deep-fried dishes!
  ✅ Once your marinade is complete - proceed with following steps :   
Do this first (Dip): Remove chicken from the mixture and let excess spill off, then coat each piece generously using a separate flour mix. This will form an outer crust when fried 🍗: Ensuring even coverage for consistent texture!  ✅ After coating with breading - continue to next step :
If that didn't work (i.e., if the chicken is soggy or lacks a proper coat), then what I need from you/is:: Confirm consistency of flour mixture, it should be light and crisp not heavy; If needed adjust with small amounts until satisfied! 🍚: Balance in breading helps maintain structure during fry.
  ✅ Once the chicken is properly coated - proceed to next step :   
Do this first (Fry): Heat oil over medium-high heat, then carefully place your pieces into hot pan or deep fat frier ensuring they're not crowded for even cooking 🍳: Temperature control in fried foods is crucial!  ✅ After the chicken has been properly heated - continue with following steps :
If that didn’t work (i.e., if it turns out undercooked or overly crispy), then what I need from you/Is: Check oil temperature, ensure around 350°F(176℃) for perfect golden brown color & moisture retention; Adjust heat as needed!
  ✅ Once your chicken is perfectly fried - proceed with following steps :   
Do this first (Rest): Remove the cooked pieces from oil using a slotted spoon to drain excess grease, then let them rest on paper-towel lined plate
